findings.reason: The cited alarm and runbook confirm the link degradation and downstream impact, supporting the root cause inference.
T1 explicitly reports traffic drops and latency spikes on S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003 for 5 hours starting at 10:30.
T2 shows S-SUD-001 depends on LNK-SUD-02-B and lists S-SUD-003 as a sibling under that link.
T3 confirms a major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on LNK-SUD-02-B raised at 10:31 and cleared at 15:33.
T4 explicitly states no changes were recorded on the specified nodes between 08:00 and 16:00.
T5 explicitly states no maintenance windows were scheduled on the specified nodes between 08:00 and 16:00.
T8 explicitly states no external events were recorded for region SUD between 08:00 and 16:00.
